notes.author: watch-doggo
notes.body: **blocker** · ReadBudget returns the os.ReadFile error untouched, so a caller reading three budgets cannot tell which one is missing. Wrap it with the path.

notes.author: watch-doggo
notes.body: **major** · A line that fails Atoi is skipped, so a typo in the budget file reads as a smaller total. Return the failure.

notes.author: jdoe
notes.body: Should this say units or hours? The budget file never says.
